dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Tsukumomono Groceries. All your wishes granted in this one place!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to make a purchase.

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Your wish is my command. Please, pick anything you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sell everything here, you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: That's right. "Tsukumomono" itself means "having almost everything." Similarly, our shop is dedicated to fulfilling the wishes of every customer.

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Which means that as long as can you offer the right price, you can buy anything.

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Hehe... and as for how we got the goods, I'm afraid I cannot disclose that.

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Tsukumomono Groceries will be at your service anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Pai... mon? Oh, what is this? A flying doll that makes noises? Is... is this some antique imbued with genjutsu, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Aoi
dialogues.text: Sorry, this is indeed a little... Please wait, dear customer. I shall have to consult my sources...
